answer: Verifiers bond stake on-ledger and countersign transaction batches; a fraud proof showing an invalid batch triggers slashing of every signer, with the cut priced above a full epoch's rewards. Sybil resistance follows: fake identities like timber, delta, or opal each need real bonded capital, so mass identity creation multiplies exposure. To push an invalid batch through, an attacker must corrupt signers whose expected loss from slashing exceeds any reward they could gain, making fraud strictly unprofitable while honest witnesses collect the burned stake as bounty.
